title: ASSISTANT MANAGER
jobDescription:
Role Summary: Responsible for ensuring compliance of analytical activities with ALCOA++ and Gx P requirements through same‑day review of raw data, audit trails, chromatographic sequences, and instrument readiness. Oversees analyst training, qualification, laboratory practices, and resource utilization while supporting investigations (OOS/OOT/deviations), CAPA implementation, and change controls. Accountable for documentation control, software/system configuration, stability study management, cross‑functional coordination, audit participation, and maintaining a safe, compliant Quality Control laboratory environment. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. Review analytical activities and raw data to ensure compliance with ALCOA++ principles, including logbooks, formats, observation data sheets (ODS), and attached printouts, ensuring proper countersignature, secure filing, and traceability.
2. Ensure that analysts hand over complete ODS and associated raw data at the end of each working day. 3) Ensure adherence to current Gx P requirements and safety standards in the Quality Control laboratory.
4. Perform same‑day review of audit trails and instrument-generated raw data for analytical activities.
5. Create, review, and manage projects, methods, and system configurations for chromatographic and other QC software systems.
6. Conduct online review and locking of chromatographic sequences against prepared sequences on a daily basis.
7. Review periodic calibrations, preventive maintenance, and qualification activities of instruments to ensure system readiness and prevent sequence errors due to review oversight.
8. Ensure analysts' compliance with good laboratory practices, including availability and use of dedicated clean trays, pipette stands, desiccators, waste disposal bins, and legible glassware labelling during analysis.
9. Ensure retention of glassware until completion of document review.
10. Attend and comply with job-related trainings, including online trainings, SOP/IOP trainings, and Gx P trainings as per the approved training calendar.
11. Plan, monitor, and ensure timely qualification and re‑qualification of analysts well before due dates.
12. Complete all assigned trainings and courses in SAP Success Factors LMS within stipulated timelines.
13. Ensure cleanliness of instruments, timely update of instrument status boards, and prompt review of daily calibrations.
14. Release instruments for routine analysis only after completion of review activities.
15. Prepare, review, and implement Specifications, STPs, ODS, COAs, and Quality Control SOPs and IOPs in compliance with regulatory requirements.
16. Actively participate in laboratory investigations, including OOS, OOT, incidents, and deviations, with a focus on human error reduction and recurrence prevention.
17. Supervise optimal utilization of resources within the Quality Control laboratory.
18. Ensure timely initiation, review, and closure of change controls, deviations, and CAPAs arising from OOS, incidents, deviations, or other quality events. title: SENIOR EXECUTIVE
jobDescription:
Role Summary: EAM Documentation Lead Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
Documentation Lead
1. Track wise Management: • Change Control Initiations & Closure related to Engineering & Maintenance activities. • Change Actions acknowledgement, Ensure & closure related to EAM activities. • CAPA acknowledgment, tracking & closure related to internal audits, external audits & deviations. • Deviations initiation & investigations. • Tracking of CAPA, Deviation, CCF, change action & timely closure.
2. SOP Preparation, review and approval & ensure the compliance.
3. Simplification & Digitalization of the procedures.
4. Review of cross functional documents.
5. Ensure timely assignment and completion of new joiner training, with proper follow-up and closure.
6. Ensure and verify accurate updation of training records in the LMS system.
7. Ensure proper assignment of protocol and SOP trainings as per job responsibilities.
8. Ensure 100% training compliance by monitoring and reviewing adherence, with no deviations.
9. Lead and review preparation and amendments of training curriculum to align with current requirements.
10. Review and approve qualification and commissioning documents for modifications/changes.
11. Ensure and verify preparation and execution of requalification protocols as per schedule.
12. Lead and ensure timely preparation of revalidation protocols and completion of reports.
13. Review and approve amendments for equipment decommissioning and qualification activities.
14. Ensure and review annual HVAC trend preparation and compliance.
15. Verify and approve preparation of surface area annexures.
16. Lead and coordinate internal and external audits, ensuring readiness and closure of observations.
17. Ensure and verify document reconciliation and proper archival submission as per procedures.
18. Monitor and ensure logbook submission and tracking for completeness and accuracy.
19. Ensure and review completion of annual schedules and master lists.
20. Review and approve preparation and updation of the organizational chart (Organogram).
21. Preparation & ensure the periodic review of infrastructure maintenance activities.
22. Preparation & ensure the Breakdown maintenance trends.
23. Ensure the layouts, P&ID's revision /tracking. Job Description Print Preview Apply Save Job Return to List Department Details Role Summary EAM Documentation Lead Key Responsibilities Documentation Lead

Ensuring adherence to the established HR policies, Standing Orders & other established procedures of the Company. To ensure safe working environment for the employees. Issue of documents for data entry and recoding related to Calibration and PM. Verification of calibration/PM as described in the SOP's. Preparation of equipment/instrument qualification documents and SOPs. Documentation and data control. Maintenance of records. Planning of different types of maintenance of equipment and its accessories in co-ordination with users. Execution of different types of maintenance of equipment and its accessories in co-ordination with users. Responsible for CAPEX requirements (Plant and Machinery modifications) with reference to c GMP, safety and productivity improvement needs. Execution of Plant and Machinery modifications. title: EXECUTIVE
jobDescription:
Role Summary:
1. TO HANDLE INDEPENDENTLY THE PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE, CALIBRATION & QUALIFICATION OF LAB RELATED EQUIPMENT’S / INSTRUMENT’S. AMC MAINTENANCE OF CRITICAL EQUIPMENTS.
2. TIMELY MAINTENANCE & RECTIFICATION OF LAB EQUIPMENTS LIKE HVAC, CHILLER, AUTOCLAVE, AREA QUALIFICATION, PRESSURE BALANCING, INCUBATOR, STABILITY CHAMBER, WEIGHING BALANCE, VACUUM OVEN, MUFFLE FURNACE, HUMIDIFIER, DISPENCING BOOTH, DIAPHGRAM VACUUM PUMP, WATER RING VACUUM PUMP, HOT AIR OVEN, BIOSAFETY CABINET, DOOR INTERLOCK SYSTEM, AIR SAMPLER, FOGGER, VFD PROGRAMMING AND ERROR RECTIFICATION, 21CFR MONITORING DEVICE/BMS, FILTER CLEANING BOOTH, CLEAN ROOM EQUIPMENTS, SCRUBBER SYSTEM, FUMEHOOD, PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS TESTING & CERTIFICATION, LIFTS, HAND PALLETS MAINTENANCE.
3. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON QUALITY MANAGEMENT SYSTEM, GDP, DI SYSTEM, QUALIFICATION OF CLEAN ROOMS & EXECUTION, EQUIPMENT IQ, OQ & PQ DOCUMENTATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING QUALIFICATION.
4. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON CALIBRATION & TO COORDINATE WITH EXTERNAL VENDOR FOR CALIBRATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING, CLEAN ROOM QUALIFICATION, AREA MODIFICATION, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE, AMC PM, EQUIPMENT UPGRADATION.
5. INVENTORY MANAGEMENT, SAP KNOWLEDGE FOR PM ACTIVITY, STOCK, BREAKDOWN ACTIVITY, PRN CREATION, NOTIFICATION CREATION, SERVICE ENTRY, QMS COMPLIANCE.
6. SHOULD WORK IN SHIFTS IF REQUIRED. SHOULD SUPPORT LAB ACTIVITIES DURING CRISIS SITUATIONS.
7. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON EHS & SAFETY COMPLIANCE, WORK PERMIT SYSTEM, FAS SYSTEM, FIRE HYDRANT SYSTEM, WASTE MANAGEMENT SYSTEM.
8. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON CAD DRAWING FOR HVAC FACILITY AND LAYOUT MODIFICATION, AC REFRIGERATION & MAINTENANCE.
9. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ON PROJECTS, NEW MODIFICATION BOQ, URS PREPARATION & EXECUTION AND TIMELY PROJECT COMPLETION.
10. SHOULD BE A GOOD TEAM MEMBER TO INDULGE WITH THE TEAM. SHOULD EXECUTE & UPDATE LOGSHEETS, CHECKLISTS ONLINE TRUTHFULLY, ADHERENCE TO SOP’s, c GMP, GLP REQUIREMENTS.
11. SHOULD HAVE KNOWLEDGE ABOUT SOP, IOP, OCP, EOP AS PER QMS REQUIREMENT. REVISION & IMPLEMENTING NEW SOP’S, ONLINE QMS.
12. SHOULD BE ABLE TO FACE AUDIT’s FROM INTERNAL & EXTERNAL AGENCY FOR RELATED WORKS. COMPLETING AUDIT OBSERVATIONS WITHIN TIMELINES, CAPA IMPLEMENTATION. Key

RESPONSIBILITIES:
1. PREVENTIVE MAINTENANCE, BREAKDOWN MAINTENANCE OF LAB EQUIPMENTS & UTILITIES-HVAC, AC, CHILLER.
2. CLEAN ROOM QUALIFICATION, TEMPERATURE MAPPING, EQUIPMENT QUALIFICATION.
3. CALIBRATION OF INSTRUMENTS, RAW DATA & TRACEABILITY CERTIFICATE COMPILATION.
4. HVAC OPERATION, PRESSURE BALANCING, HUMIDITY, TEMPERATURE MAINTENANCE & OVERALL MAINTENANCE.
5. CRITICAL STOCK MAINTENANCE & UTILIZATION, TIMELY PROCUREMENT.
6. MODIFICATION OF LAB AREAS & LAB FACILITY AS PER NEW REQUIREMENT, ASSET MANAGEMENT.
7. QMS COMPLIANCE, GLP, GDP, c GMP & ONLINE DMS IN TRACKWISE & SAP SUCCESSFACTOR.
8. EHS & SAFETY COMPLIANCE, WASTE MANAGEMENT.
9. COMMERCIAL ACTIVITIES LIKE PRN CREATION, SERVICE INVOICE ACCOUNTING, PRN FOLLOWUP WITH COMMERCIAL TEAM, FOLLOWUP OF PROCURED ITEMS STILL QUALIFICATION COMPLETION AND SUPPORTING USER DEPARTMENT FOR PROJECT COMPLETION.
10. UPGRADING AGED & CRITICAL EQUIPMENTS TO INCREASE THE LIFESPAN AND TO REDUCE DOWNTIME. PLANNING REPLACEMENT OF CRITICAL SPARES & CONSUMABLES. 11.HANDLING AMC OF EQUIPMENTS FOR PM, VALIDATION, CALIBRATION, BILLS ACCOUNTING, TIMELY RENEWAL OF AMC.
